::: {#def-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares

For a regression model whose conditional mean $\mean(x)$
depends on a parameter vector $\vth$,
the **residual sum of squares** at $\vth$
is the sum of the squared [residuals](estimation.qmd#def-residual)
$\resid_i(\vth) \eqdef y_i - \mean(x_i)$
that the model has when its parameters equal $\vth$:

$$\text{RSS}(\vth) \eqdef \sumin \resid_i(\vth)^2.$$
:::
